newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - U.S. MEMORIAL DAY MARKET CLOSES.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - U.S. MEMORIAL DAY MARKET CLOSES.

text.p: The following are announced early closes for markets on Friday, May 23.
The Treasury and related Debt markets will close trading at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT.
Forex trade is expected to wind down around 1300 EST/1700 GMT.
There is no early close on to NYMEX trading on Friday.

In Chicago, On Friday, May 23, CBOT financial and insurance products will shut early at 1210 CDT/1710 GMT but all other CBOT contracts will observe normal hours. Evening pit trading and Project A overnight sessions will be shut Sunday, May 25.
At the CME, currency and interest rate futures and options close at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT Friday. Agricultural, equity and GSCI contracts close at their regular times.
The CME said there will be an evening Globex Taiwan Stock Index session from 1930 CDT/0050 GMT to 2215 CDT/0315 GMT Friday.
The CBOE said interest-rate options trading will close early at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT on Friday, but equity options and index options will observe normal trading hours.
The following are market closes for Monday, May 26:
The Treasury and related debt markets are closed for trading in observance of Memorial Day on Monday.
Nymex for crude and products futures is also closed on Monday.

In Chicago - the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT), Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) and Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said all floor trading will be closed Monday, May 26, to observe Memorial Day.
On Monday, night pit trading and overnight Project A electronic trade will be open.
CME's GLOBEX session Sunday, May 25, will run from 1730 CDT/2230 GMT to 2230 CDT/0330 GMT. CME's GLOBEX trading will resume Monday, May 26, at 1730 CDT/2230 GMT.
